description: Defines the FFmpegDemuxerImpl class for handling media demuxing with FFmpeg, including creation, configuration parsing, packet management, and seeking functionalities.

classes.name: FFmpegDemuxerImpl<FFMPEG>
classes.description: Specialized implementation of FFmpegDemuxer for FFmpeg version handling, managing demuxing operations, packet buffering, and configuration parsing.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an FFmpegDemuxer instance for a specific FFmpeg version, returning null if unsupported.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the demuxer, setting up necessary contexts.

methods.name: HasAudioStream
methods.description: Checks if the media has an audio stream.

methods.name: HasVideoStream
methods.description: Checks if the media has a video stream.

methods.name: GetDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration of the media.

methods.name: GetStartTime
methods.description: Returns the start time of the media.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the specified stream type.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified timestamp in microseconds.
